# Where to Watch SPY KIDS: ALL THE TIME IN THE WORLD


by Angel | October 29, 2026


For Marissa Cortez Wilson, life has settled into a comfortable routine. She’s married to a famous spy-hunting television reporter, has a new baby, and is raising intelligent twin stepkids, Rebecca and Cecil. Her days as a top-secret agent are supposed to be behind her.


Then a villain with a plan to control time threatens the entire planet—and Marissa is pulled back into action. But this time, she won’t be going on the mission alone.


[Watch Spy Kids: All the Time in the World now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/spy-kids-all-the-time-in-the-world)


### **A New Generation of Spy Kids**


The *Spy Kids* franchise returns with a new generation of young agents.


Rebecca and Cecil may not have expected their stepmom to be a retired spy, but they’re about to get a crash course in secret missions, high-tech gadgets, and saving the world. When the Timekeeper puts his plan into motion, the twins find themselves right in the middle of the action.


And with the fate of the planet hanging in the balance, there’s no time for a normal family adventure.


### **A Movie the Whole Family Can Enjoy**


One of the best things about *Spy Kids: All the Time in the World* is that the fun isn’t limited to one generation.


Fans who grew up with the *Spy Kids* franchise can revisit the world with their own kids, while younger viewers get to meet a new generation of pint-sized agents.


Angel Guild members have called the movie “amazing and funny,” with one parent saying it kept their family “entertained and laughing.” Another viewer shared, “I really enjoyed this movie, and the kids will, too.”


The story also puts family at the center of all the action. Beneath the gadgets, missions, and time-traveling villain is a family learning how to work together.


### **Watch** ***Spy Kids: All the Time in the World*** **Today**


Whether it’s a first introduction to the franchise or a nostalgic return for longtime fans, *Spy Kids: All the Time in the World* delivers an action-packed family adventure with plenty of laughs along the way.


[Stream Spy Kids: All the Time in the World on Angel](https://www.angel.com/watch/spy-kids-all-the-time-in-the-world) and join the next generation of Spy Kids on their biggest mission yet.
